svg.aria-label: How jig-workflow works. Workflow files name the stages and the exit conditions of each. Evidence is produced where it can be checked: tests run in the sandbox at the exact HEAD, the plan you approved by its fingerprint, the review and CI events, gh pr view, and scenario results with evidence. Each result is saved in the ticket folder's workflow.json against the commit or the plan it is about. Status and advance read that file and the repositories as they are now and check eight conditions. A gate registered with jig-core asks the same question for each tool call and can only make a decision stricter.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
